m/106 dated 11/02/1443 hijri, “the communications, space and technology commission (cst) shall set standard specifications for communications and information technology equipment in coordination with the saudi standards, metrology and quality organization, and take the necessary measures to ensure the equipment compliance with the technical specifications set.

sa article (1) terms and definitions the terms and expressions defined in the communications and information technology system and its executive regulations, the anti-commercial fraud system, the regulation of the saudi standards, metrology and quality organization, and other regulatory cst resolutions shall have the same meanings when used in this document, and the words and expressions contained shall have the meanings associated thereto, unless the context requires otherwise.

the technical regulation: a council-approved document that sets out the characteristics of products, associated processes, and production methods, including applicable administrative provisions in force, which must be adhered to.
basic requirements: specific requirements for products that may affect safety, health, and the environment, which must be adhered to.
market situation: it is placing the product on the kingdom's market for the first time, and either the manufacturer or the importer shall be responsible for it.

article (3) objectives this technical regulation aims at determining the basic and technical requirements for communications and information technology equipment subject to the provisions of this technical regulation and setting the conformity assessment procedures that suppliers must adhere to in the product, in order to ensure that these products conform to the basic requirements that aim at preserving the integrity of the environment and the health and safety of the consumer and to ensure compliance with the technical requirements stipulated in the standard specifications, which contributes to protecting the frequency spectrum from harmful radio interference and compatibility with public telecommunications networks, in addition to verifying the fulfillment of the regulatory requirements issued by the competent authority before importing and/or using this equipment.
sa the supplier must comply with the following requirements: 4/1 general requirements 4/1/1 commitment to conduct the conformity assessment required in this technical regulation.
4/1/2 before placing and displaying the product on the market, the supplier must fulfill the technical requirements stipulated in the relevant standard specifications described in appendix (1).

4/1/3 before placing and displaying the product on the market, the supplier must fulfill the licensing, registration, and/or additional requirements following the standard specifications for the relevant communications and information technology equipment described in appendix (1).

4/1/4 the supplier must comply with the regulatory requirements issued by the competent authority, which include regulations for licensing communications and information technology equipment and regulations for exposure to electromagnetic fields.
4/1/5 information related to potential health, safety, and environmental risks must be provided, in order to take preventive measures against those risks by the relevant authorities.

4/1/6 before placing and displaying the product on the market, the supplier must fulfill the standardization requirements for smartphone chargers and electronic devices described in appendix (2) and the relevant standard specifications described in appendix (1).
4/2 technical requirements 4/2/1 it must be ensured that the devices protect humans, animals, and private property regardless of whether voltage limits apply.
4/2/2 devices must be manufactured so that they can be used effectively and achieve efficient use of the frequency spectrum in order to avoid harmful radio interference to other devices.
4/2/3 devices must be manufactured within specific categories so that they comply with the following: a.
devices must be compatible with other equipment across networks.

devices must be manufactured to ensure that they do not cause any damage to telecommunications networks or the way they operate and that they do not misuse network resources, which may cause an unacceptable service deterioration.
the devices must include safeguards to ensure that personal data and user and subscriber privacy are fully protected.
4/2/4 if the equipment contains accessories other than chargers, the technical requirements stipulated in the relevant standard specifications described in appendix (1) must be fulfilled.
4/2/5 wireless devices must contain what ensures that downloading or updating software does not affect the previously granted conformity.
4/2/6 if the device contains more than one interface, each interface must meet the relevant technical specifications.
4/2/7 safety requirements must be adhered to in the devices included in the scope of this technical regulation, which are as follows: a.
4/4 metrological requirements (standard) si units, multiples, or parts thereof must be used during the design, manufacture, or handling processes.
article (5) explanatory data product explanatory data must meet the following: 5/1 fulfilling the requirements of the saudi standard specifications shown in described (1) related to explanatory data.
sa 5/2 the data must be written in arabic, and it may be written in another language besides arabic, and what matters is what is written in arabic.
5/3 the images and phrases used must not violate the public order, public morals, and islamic values prevailing in the kingdom.
5/4 the products must be carried in a visible place and in a way that clearly shows the following information: − name and supplier information.

5/5 the supplier must ensure that the device has an indication of the model, series, serial number, or other element that allows it to be identified, or if the size or nature of the device does not allow this, the required information must be attached to its packaging or in a document attached to the device.

5/6 the supplier must indicate their name, registered trade name, or registered trademark, and the postal address at which they can be contacted on the devices, or if the size or nature of the device does not allow this, the explanatory data must be attached to its packaging or in a document attached to the device.

5/7 the supplier must fulfill the requirements of the competent authority’s badge labels that show the conformity data on the devices, or if the size or nature of the device does not allow this, the badge labels must be attached to its packaging or in a document attached to the device.
5/8 manufacturers must ensure that devices are provided by safety information in a language that is easy to understand by consumers and users.
5/9 wireless devices must include information about the band/frequency bands they support, and the maximum output power of each band.
5/10 devices must include instructions that specify the purpose of use based on the components and accessories of these devices.
5/11 the end user must be informed of the information and conditions that must be adhered to for using the devices and equipment.

sa 6/1 the supplier - responsible for placing devices subject to this regulation on the market - must obtain a certificate of conformity issued by a body approved by the authority, following the conformity assessment module (type 1a) as per standard iso/iec 17067, as described in appendix (3).

6/1/1 the approved body must implement conformity assessment procedures following the specified module, to ensure compliance with the requirements of this technical regulation and the relevant saudi standard specifications described in appendix (1).
6/1/2 a technical file must be attached to the product, and must include the following: a.
there must be design or manufacturing concepts or charts of components, sub- assemblies, circuits, and relevant similar elements.
there must be a description or explanation necessary to understand these drawings or operational charts for the devices.

6/2 the supplier responsible for displaying and/or placing the devices listed in appendix (3) must obtain a national recognition certificate (iecee) in accordance with the conformity assessment systems of the international electrotechnical organization (iec).
*note: the national recognition certificate (iecee) must cover all the requirements of this technical regulation.
6/2/1 a technical file must be attached to the product, and must include the following: a.

sa 6/3 the supplier must cooperate with the regulatory and market survey authorities, such as submitting technical file documents, certificates of conformity, and any other documented information proving that the product conforms to the requirements of these technical regulations, whenever requested to do so.

article (7) regulators’ responsibilities the regulators shall, within the scope of their jurisdiction and powers, do the following: 7/1 verifying that devices on the market meet the specified conformity assessment procedures and technical documents attached to the shipments.
7/4 when a case of product non-conformity is detected, the regulator shall withdraw the relevant products from the warehouses and take formal measures against them.

article (8) market survey authorities’ responsibilities the market survey authorities shall, within the scope of their jurisdiction and powers, do the following: 8/1 applying market survey procedures to products placed on the markets, as well as products stored in suppliers’ warehouses, to verify the safety of the products and the extent to which they meet the basic and technical requirements outlined in these technical regulations and the relevant standard specifications.

8/3 when a case of non-compliance of the product - placed and stored - with the requirements of these technical regulations is detected, the market survey authorities shall take all administrative measures, including withdrawing and recalling the product in page 14 of 41 the saudi standards organization www.

9/3 when detecting any violation of the provisions of these technical regulations, the market survey authorities must - as the case may be - take all necessary measures to remove the violation and its effects from the market.

9/4 when a violation is detected, the authority shall take the necessary measures against these products violating the requirements of this technical regulation, including cancelling the relevant certificate of conformity, and taking the necessary measures with the approved authority issuing the certificate following the regulations for approving conformity assessment bodies.

sa covered by this technical regulation shall be punished with the penalties stipulated in the anti-commercial fraud law and the regulations issued by the competent authorities in the field of this technical regulation.
article (10) general provisions 10/1 all suppliers of devices subject to the provisions of these technical regulations must maintain data specifying the following: a.
they must keep it for no less than ten (10) years and submit it to the regulators’ inspectors and market survey authorities upon request.

10/2 the supplier bears full legal responsibility for implementing the requirements of this regulation and shall be subject to the penalties stipulated in the anti-commercial fraud law and/or any other relevant regulations, should it be proven that any article of this regulation has been violated.

10/4 if any situation arises that cannot be addressed in accordance with the provisions of these technical regulations, or any dispute arises in its application, it shall be referred to a specialized committee in the authority to issue the appropriate decision regarding this situation or dispute, in a way that achieves the public interest.

10/6 the authority shall study the complaints received regarding products that have obtained a certificate of conformity or quality mark, verify the validity of these complaints, and take formal measures in the event that any violations are proven.

sa 10/8 when any modifications occur to the product during the validity period of the certificate of conformity or the license to use the quality mark (except for formal modifications), the certificate or license becomes void for this product, and a new application must be submitted.

10/9 only the authority - in coordination with the communications authority - may interpret the articles of these technical regulations, and all beneficiaries of the application of these technical regulations must abide by the interpretations they issue.

10/10 if devices that do not have a certificate of conformity are displayed at exhibitions, conferences, and similar events to display the characteristics, it must be clearly indicated on the devices that these devices may not be available in the market or may not be used in the kingdom without obtaining a conformity certificate, and it is not permissible to conduct a presentation of wireless devices except under the condition that appropriate measures are taken and approved by the competent authority to avoid harmful radio interference, electromagnetic compatibility, and risks to the health or safety of persons, animals or property.
article (11) transitory provisions 11/1 the provisions of this regulation shall be implemented within a period not exceeding 180 days from the date of its publication in the official gazette.
article (12) publication this technical regulation shall be published in the official gazette.

6) the manufacturer must inform the approved body that maintains the technical documentation for the model approval certificate of all changes introduced to the approved model, which would affect the product’s compliance with the requirements of saudi technical regulations, or the conditions for the validity of the type approval certificate, as such changes require additional approval of the initial type approval certificate.

the approved entity must keep a copy of the model approval certificate, its attachments, and additions made to it, as well as the technical documents, including the documents attached from the manufacturer, until the date of certificate expiry.

article (4): requirements for obtaining water rationalization certificate for type saso grants the certificate of water rationalization for types, when the following conditions are met: 4/1 supplier shall be officially registered at the official competent authority and having a commercial registration number.
4/2 product shall fulfill all conformity assessment procedures that prove meeting the requirements of the technical regulations regarding the product safety.
4/3 product included in the scope of this regulation shall fulfil all of its requirements and of the requirements of the relevant standards.
4/4 manufacturer shall have an effective quality management system; iso 9001 certification fulfills this requirement.
4/5 supplier shall provide a conformity declaration provided in annex (5) and provide a test report according to the requirement of this regulation and relevant standards.

4/6 supplier shall cooperate with the regulatory authorities and market surveillance authorities, by providing the technical file documents, test reports, and any other documented information proving the fulfillment of the requirements of the water rationalization certificate, upon request.
4/7 label shall be applied on the product and/or its containers by the method determined by saso in terms of type and degree, according to clause no.

article (5): steps for obtaining the water rationalization certificate for type 5/1 application to obtain a type's water rationalization certificate, the supplier shall follow the following steps: 06-04-16-156 page 8 of 23 5/1/1 apply to saso for each of the products that require a water rationalization certificate.
a valid copy of the certificate of accreditation shall be attached.

5/1/5 when applying for a water rationalization certificate for the type, the supplier shall provide saso with any data relating to the product specified in the application, and facilitates the task of obtaining a sample of the type when needed, for the purpose of verifying the extent to which it conforms to the standards of water rationalization related to the product, at his expense.
5/1/6 the supplier shall declare that all data/information provided to saso is correct and under his responsibility.
5/1/7 the supplier shall pay saso the costs of the process of granting water rationalization certification.

5/2 granting a water rationalization certificate for type saso shall perform the following procedures to grant the water rationalization certificate for the type: 5/2/1 saso shall examine the documents in accordance with the licensing procedure approved by saso for each product, to verify that the application meets all the requirements for obtaining a water rationalization certificate.

5/2/2 saso shall verify the extent to which the product meets the requirements of this regulation, in accordance with the conformity assessment form (1a) “type approval” shown in annex (4), in addition to verifying that the product meets the basic requirements in accordance with the relevant technical regulations.
5/2/3 saso shall issue the certificate of water rationalization for the type after the product has met all the requirements specified herein.

5/2/5 saso shall issue the certificate of water rationalization after the supplier meets all requirements and completes all the required corrections stated in the relevant licensing procedure, within the specified period.
the supplier shall bear the costs of withdrawing, testing, and associated matters.

article (6): label usage licensing 6/1 requirements for label usage licensing saso shall grant permission to the supplier to use the water rationalization label, when the following conditions are met: 6/1/1 the product shall have a water rationalization certificate for the type.
6/1/2 supplier shall submit a separate application to saso for each type of products intended to be licensed for label usage.
6/1/3 filling the required forms and providing saso with any additional documents upon request.
6/1/4 supplier shall fulfil the conditions of affixing the label on the products in the correct manner specified in this regulation and the relevant standards.
6/1/5 supplier shall pay saso the costs of label usage licensing.

6/2 granting the label usage license 6/2/1 saso shall verify that the product has the water rationalization certificate for the type, and the validity of all documents and information provided by the supplier.

6/2/2 saso shall determine the costs of label usage licensing preferentially, where the license to use the label is free of charge for the most water-efficient product type and the cost escalates with the reducing the level of water rationalization for each model of the product in question.
6/2/3 saso shall grant the supplier the label usage license after fulfilling the licensing requirements.

6/3 requirements of fixing the label 6/3/1 the label shall be affixed only on licensed products or their packaging, on a clear place in a way that is difficult to be removed, in accordance with the requirements specified in this regulation and the relevant standards.

06-04-16-156 page 10 of 23 6/3/2 label shall be made of a material to ensure that the label remains on the product or its packaging, from the stage of manufacture until it reaches the consumer, unless it is deliberately removed or damaged.
6/3/4 label shall be affixed on a clear place during packaging, as stipulated in annex (3) attached to this regulation.
6/3/5 label shall be affixed on the product/packaging as specified by saso in terms of type and grade, in accordance with annex (3) of this regulation.
6/3/6 the affixed label on the product shall be identical to the label approved by saso and in the manner specified in accordance with this regulation.
6/3/7 supplier shall be allowed to announce the license of label usage in their commercial transactions to prove that the products are licensed and subject to follow-up by saso.
6/3/8 license and label shall only be used for licensed products.
6/3/9 packaging materials of products shall carry the label.

procedures and penalties – stipulated in article (10) – shall be applied after taking the necessary actions.

3) the corridor between the seats, rows shall not be less than 40 cm.
4) the height between any of the seats (top of head rest) and the ceiling of the vehicle shall not be less than 85 cm.
5) the space between the front of a seat and a back of the seat in front shall not be less than 30 cm.
